description: This Java class provides a supplier for retrieving and aggregating statistics responses related to Akka shard regions. It queries shard region state, processes shard entity IDs to compute statistics such as entity counts per namespace, and constructs response objects containing this data.

classes.name: RetrieveStatisticsDetailsResponseSupplier
classes.description: A provider for fetching and aggregating shard region statistics, implementing a function that returns a completion stage of `RetrieveStatisticsDetailsResponse` based on shard state.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Executes a request to obtain the shard region state, processes the entity IDs to count per namespace or resource-type+namespace, and constructs the statistics response.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of the supplier with specified shard region actor reference, name, and logger.
